format: tracing-subscriber text via Cloud Logging textPayload

documentation.content: Inspect the public command receipt and original Agent. This is queue wait, not turn duration. Preserve accepted work; do not replay input with a new key. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

Check UI/API/Trigger latency and shared storage health during Channel rollout. This signal reports ordinary traffic delay, not proof Channel traffic caused it. If correlated, disable new Channel admission using the existing stage flags and preserve accepted work. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Agent dispatch remains ambiguous after 30 seconds

conditionMatchedLog.filter:
resource.type="k8s_container"
resource.labels.namespace_name="chrono-bot"
resource.labels.container_name="api"
resource.labels.pod_name =~ "^cma-api-"
textPayload:"cma::bridge::operations"
(textPayload:"operation=\"command\"")
((textPayload:"dispatch_overdue=true" OR textPayload:"outcome=\"runtime_lost\""))

documentation.content: Read the retained command and event history. DispatchFenced/RecoveryRequired never authorizes replay. Inspect current runtime binding and authoritative reconciliation. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Channel allocation or cleanup pending beyond five minutes

documentation.content: Use worker and work_id_sha256 to locate the original allocation/inbox/cleanup receipt. Age is since admission, not time since last progress. held=true may be deliberate authority/busy/evidence hold. Revalidate through public operations; never edit durable records. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Channel credential mint outcome is unknown

documentation.content: Reconcile the original mint intent and owner-scoped evidence. Possible orphan risk is not confirmed orphan existence. Never mint another key merely because the first reply was lost. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Channel current organization membership check failed

documentation.content: Distinguish membership service failure from intentional removal or loss of admin role. Restore service availability or have the authorized original human reconnect; do not bypass the current role check. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

conditionMatchedLog.filter:
resource.type="k8s_container"
resource.labels.namespace_name="chrono-bot"
resource.labels.container_name="api"
resource.labels.pod_name =~ "^cma-api-"
textPayload:"cma::bridge::operations"
((textPayload:"operation=\"authority\"" AND textPayload =~ "reason=\"(human_token_expired|human_refresh_failed|control_grant_expired|credential_verification_failed|credential_lease_expired)\"") OR (textPayload:"operation=\"credential_expiry\"" AND textPayload:"expiring=true"))

documentation.content: Inspect original credential custody and renewal evidence. Remaining lifetime is observed at an existing authorized renewal read. An expired lease alone does not prove the provider token expired. Preserve original owner scope and never log or copy secrets. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Channel retirement held after five attempts

documentation.content: Inspect exact retained Sandbox lifecycle and final retention assessment. Storage/history holds may be deliberate. Attempts belong to the current durable work step and are not elapsed-time measurements. Do not force finality or remove unrelated resources. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Channel outbound delivery outcome is unknown

documentation.content: Inspect the original outbox receipt and provider evidence. Use audited retry/abandon only with their documented uncertainty semantics; never silently resend. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Channel or common command worker cannot advance

documentation.content: Check Mongo/runtime availability and scheduler heartbeats. Generic worker failures do not identify root cause; inspect the bounded outcome/code and retained receipt. Ordinary commands share storage and require separate impact checks. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.

alert_policies.displayName: Channel ingress cannot durably accept work

documentation.content: Check callback custody/JWKS, capacity and Mongo health. Acceptance_unknown requires exact receipt recovery, never assumption that a message was not accepted. Authentication/bounds/payload refusals remain separately queryable without paging on arbitrary bad requests. See docs/CMA_Channel_Observability.md and docs/CMA_Channel_Lifecycle_Recovery.md.
